harvestMonths.notes: First-person own-farm observation, dependent on weather. Stock becomes available later after processing; that does not extend harvest months or validate household storage.

yieldKgPerTreeMature.notes: No qualified mature per-plant food kg with age, product basis and management context was established. Missing output remains unknown rather than zero.

chillUnits.notes: No universal numeric chilling requirement is assigned. Check the actual cultivar and site's winter conditions.

pollination.notes: Species breeding-system evidence; male trees supply pollen while female trees produce nuts. Compatible flowering and local stocking still need confirmation.

supplementaryReferences.title: Producer's own cultivars
supplementaryReferences.doc: Karoo Pistachios, first-person producer questionnaire on FoodHub
supplementaryReferences.note: The same questionnaire confirms the nuts are grown on the producer's farm. Cultivar names are reproduced as written; spelling is not a taxonomy or catalogue change.

supplementaryReferences.title: Prince Albert establishment and maturity expectation
supplementaryReferences.doc: Prince Albert Municipality, Pistachio Pioneers, 20 October 2025
supplementaryReferences.note: An expectation for the newly established Platberg project, not a measured universal age curve. Its planted cultivars are Shufra, Ariyeh and Sirora; irrigated Karoo context retained.

care: Female trees bear nuts and need pollen from suitable male trees. The Prieska reference comes from a dry, irrigated Karoo farm.
Confirm male and female planting material, irrigation and local winter/summer conditions; a February producer reference does not validate a humid coast.
purchase: Discuss Shufrah and Ariyeh from the Prieska producer evidence, or Shufra, Ariyeh and Sirora from the Prince Albert project, with a specialist nursery. Select a compatible male and confirm local fit.
